name: ai.vsize.shopping.fit
title: Fit Extension (draft)
description: Extends Catalog Search and Catalog Lookup with measurable footwear fit. A variant carries its internal dimensions; the buyer may supply a consented foot profile in request context; when both are present the variant also carries a zone-by-zone fit assessment with an explicit confidence. Fit is a comparison between two measurements, not a summary of reviews. Draft, vendor namespace; see spec for status.

signed_mm.description: Signed difference in millimetres. Positive means the shoe has more room than the foot in this zone; negative means less.

dimension_source.description: Provenance of the internal dimensions. `last_measured`: the last was measured directly. `last_derived`: derived from the last and the shoe's construction. `in_shoe_measured`: measured inside the finished shoe. `estimated`: inferred without direct measurement. Agents SHOULD treat `estimated` differently from the other three.

internal_dimensions.title: Internal Dimensions
internal_dimensions.description: Dimensions of the space inside the shoe for this variant, in millimetres. Field names follow the last and in-shoe measurement vocabulary of ISO 19409 and ISO 19410-1 where a corresponding term exists. All fields except `functional_length_mm`, `tolerance_mm` and `source` are optional; a Business publishes what it can measure.

functional_length_mm.description: Usable internal length from heel to the point the longest toe is intended to reach, excluding design allowance at the toe.

total_length_mm.description: Total internal length including design allowance at the toe.

ball_width_mm.description: Internal width across the ball (metatarsal heads).

heel_width_mm.description: Internal width across the heel seat.

toe_height_mm.description: Internal height at the toe box.

heel_height_mm.description: Heel height of the shoe, which affects how the foot sits in the other zones.

tolerance_mm.description: Expected measurement uncertainty applying to the dimensions above, in millimetres.

vocabulary.description: Human-readable reference to the measurement vocabulary used, e.g. 'ISO 19409:2022 / ISO 19410-1:2022'. Informational; see spec for the open question on externally governed vocabularies.

last_reference.description: Opaque, stable identifier for the last this variant was built on, in the Business's or assessor's namespace. Lets an agent recognise that two variants share a last.

foot_measurement.title: Foot Measurement
foot_measurement.description: Measurements of one foot, in millimetres. Field names follow ISO 7250 basic body measurements and the Mondopoint convention (ISO 9407) where a corresponding term exists. Supplied by the buyer side; provisional and non-identifying on its own.

length_mm.description: Foot length, heel to longest toe.

toe_height_mm.description: Height of the toes above the standing surface.

foot_profile.title: Foot Profile
foot_profile.description: A buyer's consented foot measurements, supplied per request in catalog `context`. The profile belongs to the buyer. A Business MUST NOT persist it beyond the request without separate, explicit consent, and MUST NOT use it to identify the buyer.

feet.description: One entry per foot. Feet differ; agents SHOULD send both when available.

measurement_method.description: How the measurements were taken. Well-known values: `phone_scan`, `in_store_scanner`, `manual`, `unknown`. Other values MAY be used.

measured_at.description: Date of measurement (ISO 8601). Feet change; assessors MAY lower confidence for old measurements.

tolerance_mm.description: Expected measurement uncertainty of the foot measurements.

consent.description: Asserts that the buyer has consented to these measurements being used for fit assessment in this request. MUST be true when the profile is present.

fit_verdict.description: Assessment of fit. `unknown` is a valid and expected value when data is insufficient; an assessor MUST NOT guess.

zone_assessment.title: Zone Assessment
zone_assessment.description: Fit in one zone of the foot.

zone.description: Zone of the foot. Well-known values: `toe`, `ball`, `instep`, `heel`. Other values MAY be used.

delta_mm.description: Shoe minus foot in this zone, after any assessor-specific allowance.

confidence.description: Assessor's confidence in this zone's verdict, 0 to 1.

fit_assessment.title: Fit Assessment
fit_assessment.description: Comparison of a foot profile with a variant's internal dimensions. Returned only when both are available. Indicative for the buyer; the agent decides how to act on it.

confidence.description: Assessor's confidence in the overall verdict, 0 to 1. MUST be present. Low confidence with a verdict is preferable to a confident guess.

foot_side.description: Which foot the assessment refers to. When both were supplied, assessors SHOULD assess the larger foot or report `both` with the limiting zone.

limiting_zone.description: The zone that most constrains the overall verdict.

assessed_by.description: Reverse-domain name of the party that produced the assessment, e.g. `ai.vsize`. Lets an agent decide whose assessments to trust.

method.description: Short, human-readable description of the assessment method, e.g. 'geometric comparison, last-derived dimensions'.

fit.title: Fit
fit.description: Fit information on a catalog variant.

fit_assessment.description: Present only when the request carried a `foot_profile` and the assessor could compare.

fit_context.description: Catalog context extended with an optional foot profile.

fit_product.description: A catalog product whose variants carry fit.

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search.description: Catalog search composition with fit (extends dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search).

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup.description: Catalog lookup composition with fit (extends dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup).
